newsitem.title: ISRAEL: Key Chinese economic official to visit Israel.
newsitem.headline: Key Chinese economic official to visit Israel.

text.p: State Planning Commission Director Chen Jinhua, the highest-ranking Chinese economic official to visit Israel, will arrive on Wednesday as a guest of Finance Minister Dan Meridor, the Treasury said on Tuesday.
It said Meridor invited the minister during the recent World Economic Forum in Davos for an eight-day visit to "deepen cooperation and to strengthen economic ties between the countries".
Chen will head a seven-member delegation from the commission and will visit major Israeli companies including Dead Sea Works, ECI Telecom, and the National Water Planning Authority.
The State Planning Commission is a ministry in charge of all social and economic planning as well as implementing macro-economic policy and economic reforms.
